product_overview: Whatomate is a WhatsApp-centric CRM platform that routes messages through a hybrid provider architecture (Meta Cloud API + self-hosted whatsmeow gateway) to deliver real-time messaging, contact management and chatbot automation for customer support and growth workflows.
core_goals: Provide reliable, authenticated agent access to WhatsApp conversations and contacts
Support high-throughput inbound/outbound messaging via hybrid providers while enabling horizontal scaling (decoupled gateway)
Secure webhook ingestion and client sessions (signature validation, JWT hardening, CSRF, strict CORS/WS origin checking)
Ensure durable, observable background processing (Redis-backed queues, DLQ and idempotency) for campaign and automation workloads
Enable chatbot automation and AI-assisted workflows (message webhook ingestion, RAG/reply drafting) with safe runtime controls

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Log in and out of the agent application, obtain/renew session authentication (httpOnly cookie + CSRF) and enforce JWT algorithm validation for tokens and SSO flows.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with httpOnly auth cookie and CSRF token -> GET /api/contacts with cookie -> Receive 200 with contacts list
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with error message
POST /api/auth/logout with valid auth cookie -> Receive 200 OK and Set-Cookie clearing session -> GET /api/contacts with cleared cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/auth/logout with expired/invalid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized (Logout requires valid authenticated session)

features.name: Contact Management
features.description: List, browse and create contacts associated with WhatsApp accounts; contacts endpoints require an authenticated agent session and return paginated data with aggregated unread counts.
user_flows: GET /api/contacts with valid auth cookie -> Receive 200 with paginated contact list (batch unread counts aggregated) -> POST /api/contacts with valid payload and auth cookie -> Receive 201 with created contact resource
GET /api/contacts without auth cookie -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
POST /api/contacts with invalid payload (missing required phone) and valid auth cookie -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors
GET /api/contacts with valid auth cookie but backend DB error -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error (client sees an error and may retry)

features.name: Chatbot Processor (Inbound Webhook)
features.description: Accept inbound message webhooks from providers (Meta / gateway) for bot processing, queue asynchronous workflows, and surface messages into agent inboxes. Webhook ingestion enforces payload signing and batch-size limits.
user_flows: POST /api/webhook with a valid X-Hub-Signature-256 header and well-formed payload -> Receive 200 OK (webhook accepted) -> Agent GET /api/contacts with auth cookie -> Receive 200 and newly created/updated contact or message appears
POST /api/webhook with missing or invalid X-Hub-Signature-256 -> Receive 403 Forbidden (payload rejected)
POST /api/webhook with oversized event batch (exceeds configured maxWebhookEventsPerRequest) -> Receive 413 Payload Too Large or 400 Bad Request (batch rejected)
POST /api/webhook with valid signature but malformed event body -> Receive 400 Bad Request (permanent failure recorded and message is classified to DLQ by background queue)
